notes: Access: www.moemax.de reached via curl_cffi chrome124 browser impersonation (site sits behind a Cloudflare managed JS challenge, per prior-pass notes; plain requests are challenged, impersonated fetch passes). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked). robots.txt DOES disallow /s/ (the site's internal search/faceted-search endpoint) for all user-agents, so no /s/ URLs were fetched; this rules out relying on on-site search as evidence, per the disallow-courtesy policy, but Sec.4's other channels (nav, footer, sitemap, CMS content pages) were fully checked instead. Checked: homepage (www.moemax.de) full HTML incl. embedded CMS/GraphQL JSON; sitemap-categories.xml (3098 URLs, no bestseller/topseller/meistverkauft/beliebt-named category); sitemap-cms.xml (547 CMS landing-page URLs) scanned for bestseller/topseller/beliebt/meistverkauft/trend-named pages -> found exactly one, /c/bestseller2025. FOUND, EXCLUDED: (1) Homepage has a CMS product-carousel widget titled 'Unsere Topseller' ('Our Topsellers', 20 items, data-childcount=20) embedded directly in the homepage layout with NO 'view all'/dedicated-URL link anywhere near it (only a carousel-skip anchor) -- this is a marketing widget, not a PLP, so excluded per Sec.3 (marketing banners / no real listing to open). (2) /c/bestseller2025 ('Bestseller 2025 bei moemax - Beliebte Moebel und Wohntrends') is a year-end recap/editorial CMS page, H1 'Das waren eure Favoriten 2025' ('These were your favorites of 2025', past tense), laid out as curated groups by room (Wohnzimmer/Esszimmer/Schlafzimmer) with 24 fixed product tiles and no totalResults/pageSize/pagination JSON anywhere on the page -- a fixed curated retrospective feature, not a live/ongoing bestseller merchandising listing, so excluded per Sec.3 (editorial/campaign page). No other candidate URLs found (no /bestseller, /bestsellers, /topseller, /meistverkauft, /beliebteste-produkte path resolves to a genuine listing; none appear in either sitemap). This company shares the same SAP-Commerce-family platform as its sister brand XXXLutz DE (SR 105, already extracted) -- XXXLutz DE's own pass likewise found no Bestsellers PLP, consistent with this finding. Absence conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists on moemax.de as of 2026-09-08.
